verdict.rationale: ClickUp offers integration surfaces (Public API, MCP server, webhooks/automations, Brain² pulling context from Google Drive/GitHub/Salesforce) that could support context-preserving handoffs between tools/agents, but there is no direct evidence of an actual seamless handoff mechanism or first-party documentation describing context preservation across agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool transitions. Missing for 10: explicit handoff/context-preservation feature docs, hands-on proof that context/info isn't lost when switching tools or agents, independent corroboration of this specific capability.
